hypothesis.claim: A call-order-exact decoder-synchronized scalar Newton correction constructed from eligible first-half observations in each 64-byte transformed-stream segment improves the second-half arithmetic payload relative to the exact constant-0.15 parent and matched controls.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject if transformed byte zero receives a synthetic prior/statistic, midpoint or reset occurs after the corresponding Advance call, the parent or bookkeeping arms drift, any inverse/repeat/state/resource/package gate fails, the Newton state is dead or non-finite, or D is not smaller than P, K, and the shifted control on the frozen population.

changedMechanism: Retain the parent PPMd log-prior and all ordinary updates, but before Advance(byte31,p32) select one clipped scalar Newton correction from eligible first-half Byte-LSTM softmax errors, apply it to bytes 32..63, and restore 0.15 before Advance(byte63,p64); transformed byte zero remains on the parent's zero-bias cold start.
invariants: P is the untouched constant-gate parent and must be byte-identical to its clean comparator.
K executes the complete live G/H/midpoint/clip/reset arithmetic but applies an exact zero correction and must remain probability-, state-, payload-, and archive-identical to P.
Ordinary PPMd, Byte-LSTM, Bit-LSTM, mixer, SSE, optimizer, memory, preprocessing, and coder updates remain at their original call sites and cadence.
The first adapted probability is for byte 32 and uses no truth from byte 32 or later.
Global transformed byte zero has the parent's all-zero initial obias row and contributes no synthetic statistic.
The midpoint gate is selected before Advance(byte31,p32), and the parent gate is restored before Advance(byte63,p64).
The episodic scalar is discarded after byte 63; no encoder-only information exists.
The PPM0 residency correction must independently pass clean/treatment byte identity before it is inherited.
All savings remain zero-credit until actual coder, exact inverse, deterministic repeat, package, resource, and control gates pass.

controls.definition: Untouched parent with compiled constant gate 0.15f.
Execute complete Scalar-MIDAS64 shadow arithmetic and reset schedule while applying an exact zero output-bias correction.
Apply the current segment first-half clipped scalar Newton correction to bytes 32 through 63.
Apply the preceding segment's first-half correction to the current segment's bytes 32 through 63; segment zero uses zero.

population.unit: raw enwik9 bytes encoded through the complete reversible pipeline
population.selection: Frozen opening 250KB diagnostic; larger and distant populations require separately frozen promotion contracts.
population.coordinate: Nonoverlapping 64-byte transformed-stream segments with first-half bytes 0..31 and second-half bytes 32..63.

availableInformation: The exact PPMd log-prior row already used for each completed first-half byte.
The exact normalized Byte-LSTM output row used for that byte before its ordinary truth update.
The decoded byte truth, existing vocabulary map, segment position, and deterministic parent state.
forbiddenInformation: Any byte truth from the adapted half before that byte is decoded.
Future segment statistics, encoder-only traces, source score tensors, fitted post-result parameters, or external runtime assets.

measurements.definition: Every completed P/K/D/S arm restores the frozen population exactly.
Each arm's repeated encode produces byte-identical durable payload.
P payload equals the clean constant-gate parent payload by byte count, SHA-256, and direct comparison.
P and K probabilities, parent state, payload, and archive are exactly identical.
K executes at least one finite nonzero gradient/curvature accumulation and midpoint construction.
Within each arm, encode, repeat, and bare decode receipts match segment index, G, H, delta, gate, Byte-LSTM state, parent state, and coder state.
Every G, H, delta, gate, probability, and state maximum is finite in every stage.
Durable arithmetic payload bytes for D.
Durable arithmetic payload bytes for P.
Durable arithmetic payload bytes for S.
Signed durable payload savings P minus D.
Signed durable payload savings S minus D.
All process-tree RSS and allocated non-memory-backed scratch limits pass.
Incremental required package bytes are at most 65,536.
All bounded scratch is removed after each terminal receipt.
